items.text: In the United States, the Democratic Party wins a majority in both the House of Representatives and the Senate in the midterm elections.
In motorsport, Kimi Antonelli becomes the youngest ever winner of the Formula One World Championship.
The Polish Constitutional Tribunal crisis escalates with the suspension of tribunal head Bogdan Święczkowski and deputy head Bartłomiej Sochański by judge Anna Korwin-Piotrowska.
